title: "T1 Shader"

# T1 by h2ee

<div id="shader-container" style="width: 500px; height: 500px; margin: 20px auto; border: 1px solid #333;"></div>

<script>
// T1 shader code by h2ee
const shaderCode = `
let pos = getSpace();
let col = sin(normal.z*30)+.3+normal.y*.6;
blend(0.9);
color(col, col, col);
for(let i = 3; i < 6; i++) {
  
  for(let j = 1; j < 6; j++) {
    rotateX(time*0.1*j*i);
    rotateY(time*0.1*j*i);
    displace(.1*i - .5, .1*j - .5, 0);
    line(vec3(0.9, -0.3, 0.1), vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.1), 0.02);  
    reset();
  }
}

let oscillation = abs(sin(time));
let endSize = 0.9;
sphere(endSize * oscillation);
`;

// Function to load shader-park-core as ES6 module
async function loadShaderPark() {
    try {
        // Try to import as ES6 module
        const shaderParkCore = await import('https://unpkg.com/shader-park-core/dist/shader-park-core.esm.js');
        console.log('Shader-park-core module loaded:', shaderParkCore);
        initializeShader(shaderParkCore);
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load ES6 module, trying UMD:', error);
        
        // Fallback to UMD version
        const script = document.createElement('script');
        script.src = 'https://unpkg.com/shader-park-core/dist/shader-park-core.umd.js';
        script.onload = function() {
            console.log('UMD version loaded');
            console.log('Window object keys with shader:', Object.keys(window).filter(k => k.toLowerCase().includes('shader')));
            // Try to find the library in global scope
            const lib = window.shaderParkCore || window.ShaderParkCore || window.shaderPark || window.ShaderPark;
            if (lib) {
                initializeShader(lib);
            } else {
                // List all new properties on window
                console.log('All window properties:', Object.keys(window).slice(-20));
                const container = document.getElementById('shader-container');
                if (container) {
                    container.innerHTML = '<p style="color: red; text-align: center; padding: 20px;">Library loaded but not found on window object</p>';
                }
            }
        };
        script.onerror = function() {
            console.error('Failed to load UMD version');
            const container = document.getElementById('shader-container');
            if (container) {
                container.innerHTML = '<p style="color: red; text-align: center; padding: 20px;">Failed to load shader library</p>';
            }
        };
        document.head.appendChild(script);
    }
}

// Function to initialize the shader
function initializeShader(shaderParkLib) {
    const container = document.getElementById('shader-container');
    
    if (!container) {
        console.error('Shader container not found');
        return;
    }
    
    try {
        console.log('ShaderPark library received:', shaderParkLib);
        console.log('ShaderPark methods:', Object.keys(shaderParkLib || {}));
        
        // Create canvas element
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width = 500;
        canvas.height = 500;
        container.appendChild(canvas);
        
        // Try different initialization methods
        if (shaderParkLib && typeof shaderParkLib.createSculpture === 'function') {
            shaderParkLib.createSculpture({
                canvas: canvas,
                fragCode: shaderCode,
                autoRotate: true
            });
        } else if (shaderParkLib && typeof shaderParkLib.default === 'function') {
            // Try default export
            new shaderParkLib.default({
                canvas: canvas,
                fragCode: shaderCode,
                autoRotate: true
            });
        } else if (typeof shaderParkLib === 'function') {
            // If it's a constructor function
            new shaderParkLib({
                canvas: canvas,
                fragCode: shaderCode,
                autoRotate: true
            });
        } else {
            throw new Error('Unable to find shader initialization method. Available methods: ' + Object.keys(shaderParkLib || {}));
        }
        
        console.log('T1 shader initialized successfully');
        
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error initializing shader:', error);
        container.innerHTML = '<p style="color: red; text-align: center; padding: 20px;">Error loading shader: ' + error.message + '</p>';
    }
}

// Load shader when page is ready
if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadShaderPark);
} else {
    loadShaderPark();
}
</script>

<small>Original shader: [T1 by h2ee](https://shaderpark.com/sculpture/-OZ3EHXk8r1JyhqgVTCy) on ShaderPark</small>

Direct implementation using [shader-park-core](https://www.npmjs.com/package/shader-park-core).
